rules: to_representation: if is_encrypted and value is not None, value=decrypt_data(value) (configuration.py:19-20). decrypt failure yields '' (exception swallowed in decrypt_data).
source = CONFIG[key].source if registered else 'db' (configuration.py:25-26); is_managed = (source == 'env') (:28). EMAIL_HOST is db-sourced per config/registry.py, hence source=db/is_managed=false.

env-sourced example (not in DB seed path): key GITHUB_APP_NAME with no DB row would still serialize source=env/is_managed=true if a row existed; such rows are never created by configure_instance (_is_db_sourced skips them).
